---
name: testing
description: Builds and maintains focused unit, integration, and Playwright coverage for AccessiWeb Engine.
---

Choose tests that exercise observable behavior, edge cases, and failure paths. Reuse existing Node tests and Playwright with axe-core rather than introducing competing frameworks. For frontend changes, cover relevant routes and themes, run the browser suite, and retain screenshots as test artifacts rather than committing generated outputs. Report precisely what ran and what could not be verified.
